tours.title: Tour packages
tours.description: Manage tour packages, publishing, and featured tours on the home page.

empty.title: No tours yet
empty.description: Create your first tour package to start taking bookings.

sections.basicsHint: Title, summary and description appear on the public page in both languages.
sections.detailsHint: Price is per person, in Indonesian Rupiah.
sections.listsHint: One item per line. Indonesian and English lines pair up in order, so both need the same number of lines.
sections.itineraryHint: One entry for each day of Duration (days). For a same-day or few-hour tour, describe every activity under Day 1.
sections.practicalHint: Practical information for guests before the trip. One item per line; Indonesian and English lines pair up in order.

fields.title: Title
fields.slugHint: Filled in automatically from the Indonesian title. Avoid changing it once the tour has been shared: old links will stop working.
fields.durationHoursHint: Optional, 1 to 12 hours. Only for 1-day tours shorter than a full day.
fields.pricePreview: Shown on the site as {price} per person.
fields.isPublishedHint: Draft tours are hidden from travellers.
fields.isFeaturedHint: Shown in the featured section on the home page.
fields.notIncludedHint: If left empty, the tour page shows: {items}.

itinerary.mismatch: The tour lasts {total, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}, but the itinerary has {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}. Make them match before saving.
itinerary.addLimit: Every day is already there. To add a day, increase Duration (days) first.
itinerary.empty: No days yet. Add at least one day of travel.

listLines.count: Indonesian {id, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}}, English {en, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}} (max. {max}).

destinations.title: Destinations
destinations.description: Manage the destinations your tours belong to, with photos and bilingual descriptions.

empty.title: No destinations yet
empty.description: Add your first destination before creating tours.

destinationForm.slugTaken: That page address is already used by another destination.

sections.basicsHint: Name and province are shown as-is. Tagline and description appear in both languages.
sections.mediaHint: Used on the destination card and the destination page hero. Use a landscape photo.
sections.accessHint: Help guests plan how to reach this destination.

fields.name: Destination name
fields.slugHint: Filled automatically from the name. Avoid changing it once the destination has been shared: old links will stop working.
fields.taglineHint: One short sentence for the destination card.
fields.descriptionHint: Separate paragraphs with a blank line.
fields.gettingThereHint: Nearest airport, harbour or road route. Leave empty if not known yet.

delete.hint: A destination can only be deleted when it has no tours.

delete.confirmBody: This destination will be permanently removed from the site. This can't be undone.
delete.inUse: This destination is still used by tours, so it can't be deleted.
